opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers to an online earning application through an external link and instructs them to download, install, and register using personal information and a mobile phone number. It portrays ordinary activities as income-producing, stating that viewers can “play and earn” and get profit through shopping, while displayed cash-out terms describe a $2 withdrawal, coin requirement, and fee. The recruitment mechanism is also explicit: a friend joining through the speaker’s link might increase earnings, with a stated 20% commission. These features establish a low-barrier reward and asset-acquisition opportunity, reinforced by the speaker’s additional earning claims and application balances. The records do not independently verify the transaction, account ownership, or viewer outcomes; routine like, subscribe, and notification prompts are audience engagement, not part of the financial mechanism.
